verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken stacking. 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has dropped below the URL line, so the reading order is scrambled. The date, subtitle, time and URL are packed into a cramped, ragged centre column with no clear left edge. The RVSP button is the same size as the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS pills, so the call to action is buried, and the warning stub is still there. Legal fine print sits at headline level in the left margin, and a dust particle covers the 'I' of the SOLSTICE logo. A's headline is slightly larger and B's has a little more room above 'Saturday', but these differences are trivial. Otherwise the two are essentially identical.
